articles.title: VS Code Adds 2-Hour Extension Auto-Update Delay to Limit Supply Chain Attacks
articles.summary: Microsoft has announced that Visual Studio Code (VS Code) will apply a two-hour delay before extensions for the integrated development environment (IDE) are updated automatically to a newer version.

articles.summary: The latest attacks, which hit 37 PyPI wheels and 19 code packages, show a continued evolution of the persistent software supply chain threat.

articles.title: VerdantBamboo Deploys BSD Variant of BRICKSTORM on Linux Appliances
articles.summary: A China-nexus cyber espionage group has been observed deploying a BSD variant of a known backdoor called BRICKSTORM, as well as two other malware families codenamed PLENET (aka GRIMBOLT) and AGENTPSD.

articles.title: Critical UniFi OS bug lets hackers gain root without authentication
articles.summary: Attackers can chain three already fixed vulnerabilities in the Ubiquiti UniFi OS server to execute remote code with root privileges and without authentication.

articles.title: Gogs patches critical zero-day enabling remote code execution
articles.summary: Gogs has patched a critical security zero-day flaw that can allow attackers to compromise Internet-facing instances and access any repositories (including private ones).

articles.title: Check Point links VPN zero-day attacks to Qilin ransomware gang
articles.summary: Israeli cybersecurity company Check Point has released security updates to patch a critical flaw affecting Remote Access VPN and Mobile Access deployments, which was exploited in zero-day attacks.

articles.title: Critical Check Point VPN Flaw Exploited to Bypass Passwords in IKEv1 Setups
articles.summary: Check Point has warned of active exploitation of a critical vulnerability impacting Remote Access VPN and Mobile Access deployments that are configured to use the deprecated IKEv1 key exchange protocol.

articles.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Vulnerability Actively Exploited
articles.summary: Cisco has issued a warning that a high-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-20245) in its Catalyst SD-WAN Manager is under active exploitation. The flaw, with a CVSS score of 7.8, affects multiple deployment types, and critically, no patch is currently available.

articles.title: AI Discovers 21 Zero-Days in FFmpeg; Chrome Patches Record 429 Bugs
articles.summary: An AI agent has identified 21 previously unknown zero-day vulnerabilities in FFmpeg, a widely used media processing library. Concurrently, Google released Chrome 149 with patches for an unprecedented 429 security bugs, highlighting the scale of vulnerabilities being discovered and addressed.

articles.title: AI-Powered Internet Worm Prototype Developed
articles.summary: Researchers have successfully prototyped an AI-powered internet worm that carries its own Large Language Model (LLM). This innovation allows the worm to operate autonomously on compromised systems, representing a significant advancement in self-propagating malware.

articles.title: IronWorm and Miasma Worm Variants Target npm Ecosystem in Supply Chain Attacks

articles.title: Miasma Supply Chain Attack Compromises Red Hat npm Packages with Credential-Stealing Worm
articles.summary: A supply chain attack dubbed 'Miasma' has compromised Red Hat npm packages, embedding a credential-stealing worm that propagates itself. This attack targets developer machines and CI/CD pipelines, highlighting the growing risks associated with compromised software dependencies.

articles.title: Dozens of Red Hat Packages Backdoored via Official NPM Channel
articles.summary: A significant security incident has occurred where dozens of Red Hat packages were compromised and backdoored through its official NPM channel. Users who have downloaded affected packages are urged to investigate immediately.

articles.title: Miasma Worm Attacks 73 Microsoft GitHub Repositories
articles.summary: Microsoft's GitHub repositories have been compromised by the Miasma supply chain attack, impacting 73 repositories across several organizations including Azure and MicrosoftDocs. GitHub has disabled access to the affected repositories due to the self-replicating nature of the worm.

articles.title: One-Click GitHub Attack Steals Full OAuth Tokens via VS Code
articles.summary: A critical vulnerability in Microsoft Visual Studio Code allows attackers to steal full GitHub OAuth tokens with a single click. This exploit enables attackers to gain read and write access to a user's repositories, including private ones, posing a significant risk to developers.

articles.title: OpenAI Codex Authentication Tokens Stolen in codexui-android npm Supply Chain Attack
articles.summary: A new supply chain attack has compromised the 'codexui-android' npm package, which provides a remote web UI for OpenAI Codex. This malicious package steals authentication tokens from developers, posing a significant risk to users of OpenAI's AI models.

articles.summary: Palo Alto Networks has issued a warning about a medium-severity authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-0257) in PAN-OS and Prisma Access that is currently being actively exploited. articles.title: Palo Alto Networks Auth Bypass Bug Under Active Exploit
articles.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks' PAN-OS GlobalProtect VPN is being actively exploited by adversaries. While exploitation requires specific conditions, attackers have already launched two waves of attacks since mid-May, emphasizing the urgency for patching.

articles.title: Stock Exchange Executive's Outlook Mailbox Compromised for Five Months
articles.summary: Unknown attackers successfully spied on a senior executive's Outlook mailbox at a major global stock exchange for at least five months, exfiltrating data in small batches. The attackers routed traffic through Dropbox and OneDrive to blend in, suggesting a sophisticated espionage campaign.

articles.title: China-Linked Espionage Groups Target Latin America
articles.summary: China-linked espionage groups have conducted cyberattacks against at least a dozen nations in Latin America, focusing on intelligence gathering related to maritime shipping and oil production. This highlights the increasing geopolitical cyber activity in the region.

articles.title: China Targets Czech Organizations with Dual-Method Cyberattack
articles.summary: China is employing a sophisticated, two-pronged spear-phishing campaign targeting high-value organizations in the Czech Republic, utilizing the Azureveil malware for data theft. This incident underscores the persistent threat of nation-state sponsored espionage.

articles.summary: Iran's Ministry of Intelligence (MOIS) is reportedly expanding its 'Handala' brand to encompass hybrid cyber and physical threat operations. This expansion involves recruiting proxies to conduct attacks, espionage, and sabotage targeting US and Israeli interests.

articles.summary: An autonomous AI tool has discovered a two-year-old remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Redis, tracked as CVE-2026-23479. The flaw, present in versions since 7.2.0, allows authenticated users to run arbitrary OS commands on the database server.
